title: Most SLEPT ON GitHub Repo For Claude Code
description:
Comment “Claude” for the Understand-Anything repo link/playbook

You built the app.
You still can’t explain how it works.

One free repo fixes that.

It turns your whole codebase into a brain you can click through.
Every file, every function, every connection, mapped.
I ran it on an app I built. 119 files. 206 connections.

Honest catch: incredible on real apps, thin on templated sites.
Still free. Still worth it.
